conditional_transfer_preconditions: Valid initialized readable source and writable destination storage, with all addressed ranges available and nonoverflowing index/address arithmetic.
Normal returns and ordinary ABI preservation by preceding helpers; source/destination receivers remain valid.
Relevant source bytes remain stable until their actual loads. Helpers, callbacks, globals or concurrent writes do not mutate those unread bytes or list headers.
For distinct variant pointers, storage is disjoint or an equally strong noninterference condition holds. Arbitrary partial-overlap snapshot semantics are not proved.
The named InfoHero field interpretation requires the current profile branch tag1; current well-formed schema tags0/1 do not constrain every integer the native helper can receive.

caller_composition.list_layout: Covered list helper uses QWORD counts, first record+8 and stride0x360 (864 bytes); retained DFE7D0 consumer uses DWORD count loads. Widths remain distinct.
caller_composition.append: Direct level/boost stores occur while creating a new record. 6B5E43 initializes variant tagFFFFFFFF at record+2BC;6B5E49 calls6BADE0 with corresponding destination/source variant addresses.
caller_composition.existing: 6B5BF7 calls6B9A50 for existing records;6B9C14 calls6BADE0 on corresponding record+2BC addresses without a preceding sentinel store in this assignment. All visible optional branches rejoin the common level/boost tail, under normal helper returns.

variant_cases.self_pointer_equality: At6BADE0 equal pointers return destination before variant-memory access. This is a property of the variant helper, not a blanket whole-record self-assignment guarantee.
variant_cases.destination_preparation: For distinct pointers, prior destination tag0/1 is replaced byFFFFFFFF before source tag is read. Other prior tags skip that invalidation.
variant_cases.source1: Constructs tag1 and copies raw bytes+4..+8. Nonzero copied presence+8 permits QWORD+0C transfer; absent payload is not copied or cleared on that path.
variant_cases.source0: Constructs tag0, forwards presence+4, conditionally DWORD+8 and always byte+0C.
variant_cases.other_source_tags: Returns without recognized source-payload construction. A previously valid destination has already becomeFFFFFFFF; otherwise its prior tag remains. No reject-all or valid-tag normalization rule is inferred.
variant_cases.current_schema_domain: USER1804->CHOICE1834 declares tag0 InfoS2(1851) and tag1 InfoHero(1852). This schema condition stays separate from native handling of other integers.
variant_cases.optional_aggregate: Current PartyAddress is a schema aggregate. The native conditional QWORD payload copy does not prove a wire-u64, address identity or lifetime rule.

remaining: Actual upstream source objects and historical per-player values remain unresolved. Current source-byte forwarding supplies no missing-field migration policy, guessed defaults or old/current variant identity.
